title: Lord Burghley to Francis Walsingham, Audley End, 2 Sept 1571 (BL Harley MS 260 ff. 143-145; DECODE R8357)

documents.shelfmark: British Library, Harley MS 260 ff. 143-145; DECODE R8357

plaintext.source: No decipherment on the images; Digges 1655 pp. 123-124 prints the groups undeciphered.

transcription.notes: One cipher line on f.143v; signs and numbers mixed.

system.summary: Numbered code groups with sign affixes, used in two short spots of an otherwise clear letter; key unknown.

prior_solution.where: Digges, The Compleat Ambassador (1655) pp. 123-124 prints the letter with the cipher undeciphered

conditions.human_role: Selected the target; the DECODE session cookie was supplied earlier.
tools: British History Online CSP Foreign ix

solution.what: Downloaded the six DECODE R8357 images with the saved cookie.
Read the clear letter: Burghley to Walsingham, Audley End, 2 Sept 1571 (not 1572); the only cipher is two items on f.143v.
Digges 1655 prints the letter pp. 123-124 with the groups undeciphered; CSP Foreign ix does not calendar it.
Tomokiyo's Cecil-Norris table (norreys1567) applied: letter-alphabet system, gives nonsense on these numbered groups.
Checked the eight other Harley 260 DECODE records (R8356, R8358-R8364) for a key or decipherment: none.

outcome.method_basis: Two short code items in Burghley to Walsingham, 2 Sept 1571 (Harley 260 f. 143v, R8357) have no key on DECODE, from Tomokiyo or in print, and Digges (1655) prints them undeciphered.
outcome.notes: Two code items, no key anywhere; letter otherwise clear and printed by Digges. DECODE date/receiver/place corrections queued.
